title: The bear that eats termites like a vacuum
caption:
Meet India's noisiest diner.

Sloth bears are mainly nocturnal. Photos: Ranthambore, Wilpattu (Sri Lanka) and a mother with cubs in Bor Tiger Reserve, Maharashtra.
